Product Profile
MTU-1153, also known as Chandra, stands as a high-yielding, medium-maturing, longbold, tall variety introduced in 2016 by RARS, Maruteru. Primarily intended for irrigated areas across states such as Punjab, Bihar, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, and Kerala, it is highly recommended for medium fertility regions during the wet season and irrigated areas in the dry season. Besides its remarkable yield potential, Chandra offers distinct advantages including high HRR, non-lodging characteristics, low shattering, and tolerance to major diseases and insect pests.
